You can find TikTok Shop creators for free using the Affiliate Center and manual research, or pay for a discovery tool that filters millions of creators in seconds. Free works when your volume is low and your time is cheap. Paid pays off the moment manual vetting becomes your bottleneck. The honest answer is that most brands start free and graduate to paid when the hours stop adding up.

What free gives you

  • The TikTok Shop Affiliate Center with basic filters by category, GMV, and follower range.
  • Manual competitor and hashtag mining, the highest-signal free method because you watch real selling behavior.
  • Zero cost, at the price of your time.

Free is enough to seed your first 15 to 25 creators and learn the mechanics. It caps out when you cannot vet fast enough by hand.

What paid adds

  • Speed. Filter millions of creators by category, GMV, audience, and engagement in seconds instead of hours.
  • Better filtering. Finer sorting than the native tool, so your shortlist is stronger.
  • Contact and workflow. Many paid tools add outreach and CRM on top of search.

Paid discovery tools and the Tokgency creator finder exist to turn days of scrolling into minutes.

The real trade-off

It is time versus money. Free costs hours; paid costs a subscription. Do the math on your own time: if manual research eats ten hours a week, a tool that cuts that to one is cheap. If you are barely searching, free is fine.

Whichever you pick, spend the saved time on fit, not volume. A popular r/UGCcreators thread warns that "a lot of creators on this subreddit are chasing the wrong brands" (r/UGCcreators), and brands make the same mistake in reverse. A paid tool that helps you find more of the wrong creators faster is not an upgrade.

Side by side

Free (Affiliate Center) Paid (discovery tool)
Cost $0 Subscription
Speed Slow, manual Seconds
Filtering Basic Advanced
Best for First creators, learning Scaling, saving time

When neither is the answer

If the bottleneck is not searching but running the whole program, recruiting, seeding, managing, then no search tool, free or paid, fixes it. That is when a managed agency does the searching and everything after.

The takeaway

Start free to learn, go paid when manual vetting becomes the bottleneck, and remember search is only step one. Match the spend to where your time is actually going.

Want to try fast search now? Use the creator finder, or book a call to have discovery and management done for you.
